battle.name: 西班牙王位繼承戰爭
battle.theater: 伊比利亞半島與加泰隆尼亞
battle.brief: 一七〇〇年十一月西班牙王卡洛斯二世病逝，無嗣而終，波旁宗室的腓力五世入主王座，歐洲隨即開戰。這場戰爭的火繩槍只屬於西班牙與葡萄牙的守備部隊：它射速慢、要點火、要瞄，在加泰隆尼亞圍城與阿爾曼薩會戰裡，靠方陣骨架與齊射維持住存在感，卻擋不住刺刀與野戰炮的世代。

kit.name: 火繩槍
kit.history: 火繩槍要點火、要瞄、要排隊。方陣把這些弱點變成了整齊的彈幕。

countries: 一七〇一年春天，歐洲分成兩大陣營。波旁一邊以法國為核心：國王路易十四自任全軍統帥，軍隊分為王家團、近衛騎兵、隸屬各團的常備步兵，以及由沃邦式野戰炮兵與攻城工程兵組成的技術兵種，指揮層級是國王—元帥—團長；法國在這場戰爭投入的陸軍人數在二十五萬至四十萬之間。與法國並肩的是波旁王朝的西班牙：腓力五世是全國國王，但軍隊並非統一指揮，而是分作三支——本土的卡斯蒂利亞軍隊、西屬尼德蘭的西班牙軍與義大利的西班牙軍，法定編制合計約七萬人，實際到員遠低於此。帝國方面還有巴伐利亞選侯麥西米利安二世率約兩萬人參戰，並有科隆與列日等小邦的零星部隊。對面是所謂大聯盟，由神聖羅馬帝國、英格蘭與蘇格蘭王國、荷蘭共和國組成：一七〇一年九月七日帝國、荷蘭與英國在海牙續訂一六八九年同盟條約，一七〇二年五月八日荷蘭宣戰，五月十五日英國與皇帝利奧波德宣戰，九月三十日帝國等級會議正式宣戰；英國女王安妮在位，荷蘭執政官海因修斯主持聯盟議事，兩國以補貼形式供養帝國軍。一七〇二年之後普魯士與葡萄牙先後加入，聯軍陸軍最高兵力約六十萬人，其中帝國軍平均二十六萬零九十人、一七一〇年峰值三十四萬三千人，荷蘭十一萬九千人，英國七萬人，薩伏依二萬六千五百人，葡萄牙一萬五千人；海軍方面聯軍有二百一十一艘戰列艦，英國一百二十三艘、荷蘭八十六艘，對上波旁一方的一百三十一艘，其中法國一百零五艘、西班牙二十六艘。聯軍的指揮體系並不統一：馬爾伯勒公爵任聯軍統帥，薩伏依的歐根親王獨掌帝國軍，兩人屢屢在戰略上意見相左，聯軍作戰多靠議會式的協調而非一個總指揮；西班牙與加泰隆尼亞一側，亞拉岡與加泰隆尼亞議會以自己的制度供給兵員與稅收，一七〇五年「熱那亞盟約」開闢第二戰線，聯軍自此在半島上有了立足點，卻因缺 民支持與補給困難，始終守不住離開海岸的內陸土地。
countriesEn: From the spring of 1701 Europe divided into two camps. On the Bourbon side France was the core: King Louis XIV took supreme command himself, and the army fell into the king's own regiments, the household cavalry, the line infantry formed in regiments, and a technical arm of Vauban-style field artillery and siege engineers; the chain of command ran king, marshal, colonel, and France put between 255,000 and 400,000 men into the field in this war. Beside France stood Bourbon Spain itself. Philip V was king of all of it, but the army was not a single command: it split into three forces, the Castilian army in Spain proper, the Spanish army in the Spanish Netherlands and the Spanish army in Italy, whose authorised establishment together came to about 70,000 men, far fewer actually under arms. The Electorate of Bavaria entered with about 20,000 under Maximilian II Emanuel, and the small electorates of Cologne and Liège contributed detachments. Opposite them was the so-called Grand Alliance, built on the Holy Roman Empire, the kingdoms of England and Scotland, and the Dutch Republic: on 7 September 1701 the Empire, the Dutch and the British renewed the alliance of 1689 at The Hague; the Dutch declared war on 8 May 1702, England and Emperor Leopold followed on 15 May, and the Imperial Diet declared war on 30 September. Britain was ruled by Queen Anne, the Dutch Republic's diplomacy was directed by Grand Pensionary Anthonie Heinsius, and both financed the Imperial army with subsidies. Prussia and Portugal came in after 1702, and the alliance could field a maximum of some 600,000 men on land: the Imperial average was 260,090, with a peak of 343,000 in 1710, the Dutch contributed 119,000, the British 70,000, Savoy 26,500 and Portugal 15,000; at sea the alliance had 211 ships of the line, 123 British and 86 Dutch, against 131 for the Bourbons, of which 105 French and 26 Spanish. The alliance command was not unified: Marlborough was captain-general of the allied army while Prince Eugene of Savoy commanded the Imperial forces independently, and the two disagreed about strategy often enough that allied operations had to be coordinated by negotiation rather than by a single director; on the Spanish side Aragon and Catalonia supplied men and money through their own institutions, and the Pact of Genoa of 1705 opened a second front in the north-east, giving the allies a footing on the peninsula, though for want of popular support and because of their logistical problems they could never hold territory away from the coast.
people: 決定這場戰爭走向的是十幾個人。西班牙國王卡洛斯二世一七〇〇年十一月一日病逝，終身無嗣，其前後兩份遺囑把王位先後指向法王路易十四的孫子安茹公爵腓力五世與其弟貝里公爵；路易十四在侄孫於一七〇〇年十一月十六日宣誓即位後，隨即在法國高等法院登記腓力五世對法國王位的繼承權，親手把王朝合併的可能推成現實。聯軍這邊的核心是奧地利大公查理：他是皇帝利奧波德一世的次子、瑪利亞·特蕾莎的丈夫，一七〇四年由里斯本登陸西班牙，一七〇八年當選西班牙國王（號卡洛斯三世），一七一一年又以皇帝查理六世的身分接替兄長，成為聯盟名義上的領袖。英國的馬爾伯勒公爵約翰·丘吉爾是歐洲最傑出的會戰指揮者，一七〇四年布萊尼姆與一七〇六年拉米利兩役都由他指揮；帝國的歐根親王是另一個名字，他自一七〇一年在義大利作戰，其後在多瑙河與萊茵反覆拉鋸，卻始終不是全軍的指揮者。西班牙戰線上是貝克維克公爵詹姆斯·菲茨詹姆斯——英國詹姆斯二世與摩拉瓜夫人的私生子，他兩度在西班牙作戰，一七〇九年四月二十五日於阿爾曼薩以少兵擊敗聯軍，一七一四年再圍巴塞羅那直至其陷落。此外還有法國元帥維多姆、維勒魯瓦、塔拉爾、維拉爾與布夫勒，薩伏依公爵維克托·阿馬德奧二世，英國的奧蒙德公爵與在加泰隆尼亞指揮的彼得伯勒，葡萄牙的佩德羅二世與若昂五世，以及在匈牙利作亂、被法國資助的特蘭西瓦尼亞王子拉科齊——他的叛亂幾乎把帝國的注意力從西班牙拉開。此外還有西班牙本土的將領：波旁軍的波波利公爵、萊納迪耶侯爵與索利諾斯伯爵，分別統率「中央軍團」「右翼軍團」與加泰隆尼亞的西班牙部隊；聯軍方面則有加泰隆尼亞方面的聖比森特侯爵，與指揮亞拉岡民兵與塞維亞分遣隊的將領。
peopleEn: The few men who decided how this war went can be counted on one hand. King Charles II of Spain died on 1 November 1700 without children, and his two wills pointed the crown first to Louis XIV's grandson Philip of Anjou and then to his younger brother the Duke of Berry; once his nephew had taken the oath on 16 November 1700, Louis XIV had Philip's claim to the French throne registered with the Parlement of Paris, turning the possibility of a dynastic union into a fait accompli. The heart of the alliance was the Archduke Charles of Austria, second son of Emperor Leopold I and husband of Maria Theresa; he landed in Spain from Lisbon in 1704, was proclaimed king of Spain as Charles III in 1708, and in 1711 succeeded his brother as Emperor Charles VI, becoming the nominal leader of the coalition. John Churchill, Duke of Marlborough, was the ablest battle commander in Europe, and Blenheim in 1704 and Ramillies in 1706 were both fought under his command. Prince Eugene of Savoy was the other great name, campaigning in Italy from 1701 and then along the Danube and the Rhine, but he was never commander of the whole army. On the Spanish side stood the Duke of Berwick, James FitzJames, the illegitimate son of James II of England and Arabella Churchill; he campaigned twice in Spain, beat the allies at Almansa on 25 April 1709 with a smaller force, and in 1714 besieged Barcelona until it fell. Around them come the French marshals Vendôme, Villeroy, Tallard, Villars and Boufflers; Victor Amadeus II of Savoy; the Duke of Ormonde and Peterborough, who commanded in Catalonia; Peter II and John V of Portugal; and the Transylvanian prince Rákóczi, whose revolt in Hungary, financed by France, pulled Imperial attention away from Spain almost entirely. To these must be added the Spanish commanders: the Duke of Popoli, the Marquis of la Renaudière and Count Salinas, who led the Bourbon army of the Centre, the army of the Right and the Spanish troops in Catalonia; on the other side the Marquis of San Vicente, who led the Aragonese and the detachments raised in Catalonia and Valencia.
kits: 這場戰爭裡的火繩槍，是西班牙與葡萄牙軍隊仍在使用的舊式火器，而它恰好是整場衝突最具符號性的裝備。一七〇二年西班牙炮兵軍官何塞·阿梅斯基塔整編軍制：舊日的方陣被改為十二連隊的營，大段長矛逐步取消，改以火槍兵為主，武器規格也統一到一種約三點五口徑的火繩槍；火繩槍需事先把火繩點燃並在叉架上備好火藥盤，開火前要換繩、要取架、要瞄，射速遠低於燧發槍，瞄準也不能像燧發機關那樣隨手即發，因此西班牙步兵只能靠齊射與整齊的方陣骨架維持火力密度，最後以長矛與刺刀接戰收尾；火繩槍同時是各營警衛、旗手與炮兵護衛的制式配槍，一七〇四年直布羅陀的守備主力是西班牙團與英國陸戰隊，圍城裡坑道與突牆之間消耗的正是這類老式火器的彈藥。其餘各方的火力骨幹早已換代：法國在一七〇〇年前後完成燧發槍（miquelet）換裝，奧地利帝國在利奧波德一世治下以 Infanteriemodell 線列步槍配插座刺刀編制，英國陸軍使用燧發的棕貝絲式長槍，荷蘭與葡萄牙的部分部隊仍混用火繩槍。火炮方面，西班牙保有可觀數量的青銅野戰炮與十二磅、二十四磅重炮，聯軍則有荷蘭所獨有的攻城工程兵，以及成排的攻城臼炮、壕溝器材、擲彈、攻城塔與爆破用的地雷箱；騎兵有胸甲騎兵、龍騎兵、驃騎與名聲在外的土耳其騎兵，輕裝火槍騎兵用短筒的 espingarda；後勤靠牛車與大篷車隊，傷兵靠隨軍醫院車隊，攻城與野戰的補給線幾乎全部沿萊茵、多瑙與伊比利亞海岸的港市維持。
kitsEn: The matchlock musket in this war was an obsolete weapon still carried by the Spanish and Portuguese armies, and it happened to be the most emblematic piece of equipment in the whole conflict. In 1702 the Spanish artillery officer José de Amezquita reorganised the army: the old tercios were recast as battalions of twelve companies, the long pikes were gradually abandoned in favour of musketeers, and the weapons were standardised on a single type of matchlock musket of about three and a half calibre. A matchlock required the match to be lit in advance and the pan charged while the piece rested on its fork; before firing the soldier had to change the match, lift the rest and take aim, so its rate of fire was far below that of a flintlock and it could not be brought to bear as instantly as a flint mechanism. Spanish infantry could therefore maintain volume of fire only through volley fire and a rigid framework of squares, finishing the business with pike and bayonet. The matchlock remained the regulation weapon of the guards, colour bearers and artillery escorts of each battalion; the defence of Gibraltar in 1704 rested mainly on a Spanish regiment and British marines, and in that siege the ammunition spent between saps and casemates was very largely of this old type. The rest of the belligerents had already changed generations in the armament of their infantry: France completed its rearmament with the miquelet flintlock around 1700, the Imperial army under Leopold I was organised on the Infanteriemodell line musket with a socket bayonet, the British army used the flintlock long gun known as the Brown Bess, and some Dutch and Portuguese formations still mixed in matchlocks. On the artillery side Spain retained a considerable number of bronze field guns and twelve- and twenty-four-pounder heavy pieces, while the alliance possessed the only substantial siege engineering corps in the war, in the Dutch service, together with batteries of siege mortars, trench tools, petards, siege towers and the powder charges used for mining. The cavalry included cuirassiers, dragoons, hussars and the famous Turkish riders, while light fusileros carried the short-barrelled espingarda. On the logistics side, supply moved on ox carts and heavy wagons, the wounded travelled with the field hospital trains, and the lines of supply for both siege and field operations ran almost entirely along the Rhineland, the Danube and the ports of the Iberian coast.
tactics: 作戰方式上，這場戰爭是兩套制度交手的樣本。聯軍在歐洲大陸走的是省吃儉用、各自為戰的聯盟式打法：一七〇四年多瑙河戰役中，歐根親王率帝國軍在布萊恩海姆方向施壓，馬爾伯勒則於八月二日率英荷主力渡過多瑙河直取塔拉爾的側背，八月十三日布萊尼姆會戰遂以縱隊迂迴與黃昏時分英國騎兵連同丹麥、瑞典旅的衝鋒收掉戰局；一七〇六年五月十二日拉米利會戰，馬爾伯勒再以斜線攻勢讓縱隊逐次投入，插入法西聯軍兵力最多卻最不整齊的一翼。西班牙與加泰隆尼亞的步兵則依靠方陣與齊射：火繩槍的射速限制使它必須分批點名齊射，第一線射擊、第二線裝填的交替射擊在操典中被嚴格規定，方陣四角由長矛兵與火槍兵混合支撐。西班牙的戰術缺陷在阿爾曼薩暴露無遺：一七〇九年四月二十五日，聯軍縱隊在狹窄地形裡逐批投入，被貝克維克以縱深配置與一次假性退卻分割，法西聯軍的騎兵反擊切斷了英葡聯軍的退路。另一個戰場是圍城術：巴塞羅那自一七〇五年起被圍，至一七一四年方告陷落，最後一次圍城以蒙奇維克要塞下方的坑道爆破為勝負手，聯軍最終攻入城中，守軍於七月十一日簽署投降書；直布羅陀一七〇四年至一七〇五年的圍城則是西班牙守軍以坑道與反斜面炮位對抗英荷聯軍，聯軍終因疫病與攻城手段不足而放棄陸路圍攻，改取封鎖。
tacticsEn: In method this war was a collision between two systems. On the continent the alliance fought the frugal, separate way typical of a coalition: in the Danube campaign of 1704 Prince Eugene pressed in the direction of Blindheim while Marlborough crossed the Danube on 2 August with the main British and Dutch body to fall on Tallard's flank and rear, and the battle of Blenheim on 13 August was settled by the turning movement of the columns and, at dusk, by the charge of the English cavalry together with the Danish and Swedish brigades; at Ramillies on 12 May 1706 Marlborough used the oblique attack a second time, feeding his columns in one after another into the wing of the Franco-Spanish army that was strongest in numbers but least in order. Spanish and Catalan infantry depended on the square and on volley fire: the rate of fire of the matchlock compelled them to fire by company in turn, the alternation of first line shooting and second line loading was minutely prescribed in the drill books, and the corners of the square were propped by pike and shot together. The weakness of the Spanish tactical system was laid bare at Almansa: on 25 April 1709 the allied columns entered piecemeal into narrow ground and were separated by Berwick's depth and a feigned retreat, while the Franco-Spanish cavalry cut off the retreat of the English and Portuguese. The other form of this war was the siege. Barcelona was held under siege from 1705 until it fell in 1714, and the last siege was decided by the mine driven beneath the Montjuïc fortress, the allies breaking into the city and the garrison signing the capitulation on 11 July; the siege of Gibraltar in 1704 and 1705 was a contest in which the Spanish garrison answered the Anglo-Dutch from its saps and its casemated batteries, and the allies eventually abandoned the land siege because disease and the inadequacy of their siege methods made it hopeless, turning instead to blockade.
data: 可核對的數字大致如下。戰爭自一七〇一年三月算起，至一七一四年九月七日停火，前後十三年；一七一三年四月十一日《烏得勒支條約》、一七一四年三月六日《拉施塔特條約》與一七一四年《巴登條約》分別終結英葡荷與西班牙的戰事，以及奧地利與法國的戰事。兵力上限：波旁一方陸軍約五十萬人，其中法國二十五萬至四十萬人、西班牙法定七萬人（卡斯蒂利亞二萬、西屬尼德蘭三萬五千、義大利一萬五千，實際到員遠低）、巴伐利亞二萬人；聯軍陸軍最高約六十萬人，帝國軍平均二十六萬零九十人、一七一〇年峰值三十四萬三千人，荷蘭十一萬九千人、英國七萬人、薩伏依二萬六千五百人、葡萄牙一萬五千人。海軍：聯軍二百一十一艘戰列艦（英一百二十三、荷八十六），波旁一百三十一艘（法一百零五、西二十六）。傷亡：波旁一方約六十萬至七十萬人陣亡、受傷或病亡，其中法國五十萬至六十萬人，西班牙與巴伐利亞合計約十萬人；聯軍一方約五十萬至六十萬人，其中英荷合計二十五萬人陣亡受傷（英軍士兵死亡三萬二千人），帝國方面二十萬人，葡萄牙五萬人，薩伏依五萬人。會戰層面：一七〇四年八月十三日布萊尼姆，法軍損失約兩萬人、被俘約一萬四千人，聯軍損失僅約四千至五千人；一七〇六年五月十二日拉米利，英荷聯軍約二萬二千人對法西聯軍約六萬人，聯軍傷亡約一千五百人；一七〇九年四月二十五日阿爾曼薩，貝克維克麾下約一萬八千人對聯軍約二萬人，聯軍陣亡、受傷與被俘合計約四五千人；一七〇二年十月二十三日維戈灣，英荷聯軍擊沉西班牙寶船隊約十八艘，另毀三艘法國戰艦，船上載運的白銀以數百萬鎊計。戰爭在美洲與加勒比另有延伸：英西兩國在北美、牙買加與加勒比海互相攻擊，屬於安妮女王戰爭的範圍，雙方海軍損失與私掠船的活動同樣以萬計。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked run roughly as follows. The war is counted from March 1701 to the armistice of 7 September 1714, a matter of thirteen years; the Treaty of Utrecht of 11 April 1713, the Treaty of Rastatt of 6 March 1714 and the Treaty of Baden of 1714 ended the fighting between Britain, Portugal and the Dutch on the one hand and Spain on the other, and then the war between Austria and France. At the peak the land forces on the Bourbon side numbered about 500,000 men, of whom France provided 255,000 to 400,000 and Spain had an authorised establishment of 70,000 (20,000 in Castile, 35,000 in the Spanish Netherlands and 15,000 in Italy, with the numbers actually under arms far lower), while Bavaria contributed 20,000; on the other side the alliance could reach about 600,000 men, with the Imperial army averaging 260,090 and peaking at 343,000 in 1710, the Dutch at 119,000, the British at 70,000, the Savoyards at 26,500 and the Portuguese at 15,000. At sea the alliance had 211 ships of the line, 123 British and 86 Dutch, against 131 for the Bourbons, 105 French and 26 Spanish. Casualties: on the Bourbon side some 600,000 to 700,000 were killed, wounded or died of disease, of whom France accounted for 500,000 to 600,000 and Spain and Bavaria together for about 100,000; on the allied side between 500,000 and 600,000, of whom Britain and the Dutch together lost 250,000 killed and wounded, including 32,000 British soldiers dead, the Empire 200,000, Portugal 50,000 and Savoy 50,000. At the level of individual battles: at Blenheim on 13 August 1704 the French lost about 20,000 men, of whom some 14,000 were taken prisoner, while the allies lost only some four to five thousand; at Ramillies on 12 May 1706 about 22,000 British and Dutch faced perhaps 60,000 Franco-Spanish troops, and the allies lost around 1,500 men; at Almansa on 25 April 1709 Berwick's force of about 18,000 faced some 20,000 allies, and the allies lost roughly four to five thousand killed, wounded or captured; at Vigo Bay on 23 October 1702 the Anglo-Dutch squadron sank about eighteen Spanish treasure ships and destroyed three French warships, carrying silver valued in the millions of pounds. The war also ran on into the Americas and the Caribbean, where Britain and Spain attacked one another in North America, Jamaica and the islands, a theatre known as Queen Anne's War, with naval losses and privateering on a comparable scale.
cause: 打起來的根子在王位繼承。卡洛斯二世自一六六五年即位，終身無嗣，歐洲列強為此折衝了三十年：一六九八年海牙條約一度把巴伐利亞的約瑟夫·斐迪南立為西班牙王位繼承人，但他在次年二月因天花夭折；一七〇〇年《倫敦條約》改立奧地利大公查理，但西班牙方面並未真正接受任何分割方案。卡洛斯二世的遺囑把整個西班牙王國留給路易十四的孫子安茹公爵腓力，路易十四在侄孫宣誓即位後隨即毀約，否認第二份遺囑，理由是西班牙與法國合併會使歐洲天平衡被打破，法國的體量足以壓倒一切鄰國，也會讓其他列強沒有安全可言。法國與西班牙之間的《聖伊爾德豐索密約》給了波旁王朝在伊比利亞半島的抓手，而把西班牙的荷蘭屏障要塞交給傾向法國的巴伐利亞選侯麥西米利安二代為看守，等於直接威脅荷蘭共和國的西屬尼德蘭屏障與英國的貿易航線；法國在帝國等級會議上以樞機主教代表施壓，要求支持巴伐利亞的選舉，為荷蘭與英國所不能容忍。荷蘭於一七〇二年五月八日宣戰，英國五月十五日、神聖羅馬帝國等級會議九月三十日跟進；西班牙的內部反應也把戰爭拉長，亞拉岡、加泰隆尼亞與瓦倫西亞先後倒向大公查理，馬略卡、那不勒斯、西西里與撒丁則擁立腓力五世，兩個西班牙同時上陣，戰爭因此從王朝危機升級為全面歐洲戰爭。
causeEn: The root of the conflict was the succession. Charles II had reigned since 1665 and died childless, and the European powers had jockeyed over the question for thirty years: the Treaty of The Hague of 1698 for a moment designated the Bavarian Joseph Ferdinand as heir to the Spanish crown, but he died of smallpox in the February of the following year; the Treaty of London of 1700 shifted the claim to the Archduke Charles, but Spain had never truly accepted any partition of the monarchy. Charles II's will left the whole of Spain to Louis XIV's grandson Philip of Anjou, and once the grandson had taken the oath, Louis XIV promptly tore up the second will on the ground that a union of Spain and France would break the balance of power in Europe: the size of France would overawe every neighbour, and no other power could consider itself secure. The Treaty of San Ildefonso between France and Spain gave the new Bourbon dynasty its grip on the Iberian peninsula, and the handing of the Spanish Netherlands barrier fortresses to the pro-French Elector of Bavaria, to be garrisoned by Bavarian troops, directly threatened the Dutch barrier and the English trade routes; in the Imperial Diet France pressed through a papal nuncio for the votes of the electors in favour of Bavaria, which the Dutch and the English could not accept. The Dutch declared war on 8 May 1702, England followed on 15 May and the Imperial Diet on 30 September. The internal divisions of Spain prolonged the war as well: Aragon, Catalonia and Valencia turned to the Archduke, while Majorca, Naples, Sicily and Sardinia declared for Philip V, so that two Spains fought at the same time and a dynastic crisis was turned into a general European war.
impact: 這場戰爭改寫了歐洲的權力地圖。第一，帝國的西翼被永久性改寫：西班牙的尼德蘭、米蘭、那不勒斯與撒丁王國歸入奧地利，薩伏依取得西西里，荷蘭取得屏障要塞與上格爾德的沿邊據點，奧地利從此在西西里亞與倫巴第把法國與帝國本土夾在中間，義大利的「義大利方案」在梅納爾迪與奧利沃內開啟，日後成為歐洲大陸政策的主軸。帝國的軍制也隨之改頭換面：一七〇二年阿梅斯基塔的營制改革把西班牙方陣廢掉，火繩槍逐步讓位於燧發槍，比利時的宿營與攻城術在維也納被系統引進，西班牙的野戰炮隊與工兵在義大利與加泰隆尼亞戰場累積的經驗，反過來改寫了帝國的軍官學校。第二，英國靠這場戰爭完成了一次海權交接：皇家海軍接管西地中海的航路，直布羅陀與梅諾卡落入英國手中，荷蘭的商業優勢開始被英國取代，同時英國拿到了向西班牙殖民地販運黑奴的 asiento 契約，英格蘭銀行也在一七〇四年成立，成為國家的融資工具。第三，西班牙本土的政治結構被重寫：一七一四年巴塞羅那陷落，一七一六年新王國法規取消加泰隆尼亞的憲法與自治制度、加泰隆尼亞議會被解散，歐洲式的王位繼承原則取代了原有的憲章。第四，王朝問題並未就此結束：一七一三年路易十四的遺囑把法國王位優先留給腓力五世的孩子，一七二四年腓力五世退位、法國的路易一世即位又猝死，一七二四年的波旁密約與一七一八至一七二〇年的四國聯盟戰爭，才算把這場繼承危機的最後一段補完。
impactEn: This war redrew the political map of Europe. First, the western wing of the Empire was permanently reshaped: the Spanish Netherlands, Milan, Naples and the kingdom of Sardinia passed to Austria, Savoy received Sicily, the Dutch recovered their barrier fortresses and part of Upper Guelders, and Austria henceforth stood between France and the Empire proper in Lombardy and Sicily, opening the so-called Italian plan that ran through Menarolo and Olivone and would dominate continental policy for a generation. The military system of the Empire was reshaped with it: the Spanish tercio was abolished by the battalion reform of 1702, the matchlock gave way by degrees to the flintlock, the billeting and siegecraft of the Low Countries were introduced systematically at Vienna, and the experience of the Spanish artillery and engineers in Italy and Catalonia was written back into the Imperial officer schools. Second, Britain used the war to complete a handover of sea power: the Royal Navy took command of the western Mediterranean, Gibraltar and Menorca remained in British hands, the commercial advantage of the Dutch began to be replaced by the English, and Britain obtained the asiento for supplying slaves to the Spanish colonies; the Bank of England was founded in 1704 as the instrument of national finance. Third, the internal structure of Spain itself was rewritten: with the fall of Barcelona in 1714, the Nueva Planta of 1716 abolished the constitution and the self-government of Catalonia and dissolved its estates, and a European principle of succession took the place of the old charters. Fourth, the dynastic question was not thereby closed: the will of 1713 left the French crown in the first instance to the children of Philip V, Philip V abdicated in 1724 and his successor Louis I died within the year, and it took the Bourbon compact of 1724 and the War of the Quadruple Alliance from 1718 to 1720 to close the last chapter of this succession crisis.
result: 結果是一次雙贏式的分割。腓力五世保住西班牙王位，卻放棄法國王位的繼承權；法國得到奧蘭治親王領與烏巴耶河谷，卻失去西屬尼德蘭與巴伐利亞的盟位；奧地利拿到米蘭、那不勒斯與西屬尼德蘭，荷蘭拿回屏障，葡萄牙得到南美的哥倫比亞殖民地，薩伏依得到西西里，英國得到直布羅陀、梅諾卡與 asiento。戰爭的終點嚴格說有兩個：一七一三年四月十一日《烏得勒支條約》結束英、葡、荷與西班牙的戰事，一七一四年三月《拉施塔特條約》與《巴登條約》把奧地利與法國拉回戰前格局；但加泰隆尼亞的抵抗並未隨條約停止，英國支持的聯軍仍圍著巴塞羅那打到一七一四年七月十一日守軍投降，維拉羅埃爾率領的加泰隆尼亞部隊在此役之後被解散，腓力五世才真正握有整個伊比利亞半島。從兵器的角度看，火繩槍在這場戰爭裡走完了最後一段路：一七〇二年的西班牙軍制改革把它從方陣骨架降為齊射工具，一七〇四年直布羅陀的守備與一七一四年蒙奇維克的坑道戰裡還聽得到它的聲音，但它從未再是決定任何一場會戰的東西——會戰是由燧發槍、刺刀與野戰炮決定的；而這場戰爭真正的勝負手也不在火器上，而在聯盟的錢、港與時間：法國的財政被拖到極限，英荷的海軍與海外基地決定了加泰隆尼亞戰線能撐多久，聯盟內部的裂痕則在最後兩年裡把一個仍在抵抗的西班牙推回了波旁王座。
resultEn: The result was a partition that satisfied both sides. Philip V kept the crown of Spain but renounced his place in the French succession; France gained the Principality of Orange and the Ubaye valley but lost the Spanish Netherlands and Bavaria as an ally; Austria received Milan, Naples and the Spanish Netherlands, the Dutch recovered their barrier, Portugal obtained the Colombian colony in South America, Savoy received Sicily, and Britain kept Gibraltar, Menorca and the asiento. Strictly speaking the war had two endings: the Treaty of Utrecht of 11 April 1713 closed the fighting between Britain, Portugal and the Dutch on one hand and Spain on the other, and the Treaties of Rastatt and Baden of March and July 1714 brought Austria and France back to the situation before the war. But the resistance of Catalonia did not stop with the treaties, and the British-supported allies kept Barcelona besieged until the garrison capitulated on 11 July 1714; the Catalan troops commanded by Villarroel were disbanded after that defeat, and only then did Philip V hold the whole Iberian peninsula in his hands. From the point of view of weapons, the matchlock ran the last part of its road in this war: the Spanish reform of 1702 reduced it from the framework of the square to an instrument of volley fire, and it could still be heard in the defence of Gibraltar in 1704 and in the mine warfare under Montjuïc in 1714, but it never again decided a single battle, for battles were decided by the flintlock, the bayonet and the field gun. Nor was the true weight of this war in the firearms at all, but in the money, the ports and the time of the alliance: French finances were pushed to their limit, the British and Dutch fleets and their overseas bases decided how long the Catalan front could hold, and the cracks inside the alliance pushed a Spain that was still resisting back onto the Bourbon throne in the last two years.
